name: AXM Asset Vault
summary: Shared local-first asset library mounted behind Publish & Library and available contextually inside Studio.
notes: Asset Vault is presented through Publish & Library as the shared catalog and remains available contextually inside Studio. This compatibility route preserves existing data and saved links. Real folder indexing is a later bridge/server step.
no_fake_done: Real folder watching/indexing is not built in v0.2.
Automatic zipped asset packs are not built in v0.2.
Launcher reads static manifest.card metadata, but exported card packets still require a later install step.
Registry link is page-runtime local in v0.2, not persistent server-wide yet.
